assumptions: Customer wants existing external calls brought into compliance, not only a policy that flags them later
Fail-closed (throw) is the right catch behaviour for payment, fraud, refund, quote and bank-link calls
Runtime default timeout of 10 seconds applies to calls that omit timeout
Policies advisory and active, per template default; blocking is the owner's choice
confusions: xano policy parse output dropped the severity line from the normalised file, so it is unclear whether severity was stored
Catalogue lists templates as LOG-010 under 'Integrations' and 'Code review' categories; had to read both to find the rule
No example in the skill of throw syntax inside a catch; wrote throw { value = ... } from the skill's param list and relied on dry-run to validate
Unclear whether a variable declared with 'as' inside try is visible after try_catch, so catch blocks set a fallback var as the existing acme_get_tracking does
wished_for: A recipe or sample showing throw inside catch in XanoScript
A check that bounds retry attempts in tasks (the task retry gap)
Coverage for ai.external.mcp and db.external calls, which have no timeout param
why_confidence: Both rules are template checks that pass as written and the dry run is clean. Coverage is limited to api.request, stream.from_request and webflow.request, and the catch check tests presence of a try only. The hang caused by the uncapped retry task and the uncovered MCP and direct-query calls remain.
